snippet.title: Swarm Me - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
A minimalist horde survival arena where you’re hunted by an endless swarm of drones - kite the horde, bait them into deadly traps, upgrade your defenses, use special items and survive as long as you can. Every minute the swarm grows denser, faster, and deadlier.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4033100/Swarm_Me/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:
